description: This file contains utility functions for handling USP protocol messages, including creating requests and processing responses, for a network management system. It includes functions for adding parameters to set requests, validating responses, and parsing various USP message types.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_AddSetReq_Param
methods.description: Adds a parameter to a USP Set request, creating update objects as needed.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ValidateUspResponse
methods.description: Validates that a USP message response is of the expected type and handles error cases.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_GetReq
methods.description: Constructs a USP Get request message from a list of keys.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_SetReq
methods.description: Constructs a USP Set request message from key-value pairs.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_AddReq
methods.description: Creates a USP Add request message for creating a new object instance.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Extend_AddReq
methods.description: Adds additional objects to an existing USP Add request message.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_DeleteReq
methods.description: Creates a USP Delete request message for deleting objects.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_OperateReq
methods.description: Creates a USP Operate request message for executing commands.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_GetInstancesReq
methods.description: Creates a request to get all instances of specified data model objects.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_Create_GetSupportedDMReq
methods.description: Creates a request to get supported data model paths and parameters.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_GetResponse
methods.description: Processes a Get response from a USP service, populating key-value vector.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_SetResponse
methods.description: Processes a Set response from a USP service, checking success or failure.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_AddResponse
methods.description: Processes an Add response, extracting instance number and keys.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_DeleteResponse
methods.description: Processes a Delete response, verifying success or failure.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_OperateResponse
methods.description: Processes an Operate response, extracting output arguments.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_GetInstancesResponse
methods.description: Processes a GetInstances response, returning object paths.

methods.name: MSG_UTILS_ProcessUspService_GetSupportedDMResponse
methods.description: Processes a GetSupportedDM response, returning supported paths and types.

methods.name: ParamTypeToUspServiceString
methods.description: Converts protobuf parameter type enum to string.

methods.name: FindUpdateObject
methods.description: Finds an existing update object in a set request by object path.

methods.name: AddSetReq_UpdateObject
methods.description: Adds a new update object to a set request.

methods.name: AddUpdateObject_ParamSettings
methods.description: Adds a parameter setting to an update object.

methods.name: AddSetReq_Param
methods.description: Adds a parameter to a set request, creating update objects as needed.
